# Lähijunat Live

> Real-time departure boards for Finland's commuter trains. Pick a departure and a destination station and see the next trains with delays, track numbers and journey times, in Finnish, Swedish or English. Free, no account, works offline as an installable web app.

Lähijunat Live is a static site: every station, every station pair with direct service and every commuter line has its own URL that is complete without JavaScript. Live train data is fetched in the browser from Fintraffic's open Digitraffic API. Page titles and descriptions are in Finnish; the interface follows the reader's language.

URL patterns:

- `/{station}/` — departures from one station, by lowercase short code, e.g. `/hki/` for Helsinki
- `/{from}/{to}/` — trains between two stations, e.g. `/hki/ke/` for Helsinki to Kerava
- `/linja/{letter}/` — one commuter line and its stations in travel order, e.g. `/linja/k/`

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.lahijunat.live/): choose stations and see live departures
- [All stations](https://www.lahijunat.live/asemat/): every station, alphabetically, with the lines that call there
- [Lines](https://www.lahijunat.live/linjat/): every commuter line and its route
- [K train](https://www.lahijunat.live/linja/k/): example line page, Helsinki to Kerava
- [Helsinki](https://www.lahijunat.live/hki/): example station page
- [Sitemap](https://www.lahijunat.live/sitemap-index.xml): index of every public page

## Data

- [Digitraffic railway traffic API](https://www.digitraffic.fi/en/railway-traffic/): source of all train data, provided by Fintraffic under the CC BY 4.0 licence
- [Digitraffic status](https://status.digitraffic.fi/): service status of the data source

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/nikosalonen/lahijunat.live): source code, MIT-licensed, built with Astro, Preact, Tailwind CSS and TypeScript
